definitions.explanation: A sleeveless shirt with shoulder straps, worn as a casual summer top or as inner/sports wear. Used by men and women alike.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧タンクトップ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{涼|すず}しい→涼しい：00674_suzushii⟧。
examples.english: Tank tops are cool in summer.

examples.japanese: ⟦ジム→ジム：04735_jimu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧タンクトップ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着替|きが}えた→着替える：04603_kigaeru⟧。
examples.english: I changed into a tank top at the gym.

examples.japanese: ⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧タンクトップ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{羽織|はお}った→羽織る：13901_haoru⟧。
examples.english: I threw a shirt on over my white tank top.

notes:
Loanword from English. The name comes from old-style swimming pools called "tanks" where similar tops were worn.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- タンクトップ⟦{一枚|いちまい}→一枚：08889_ichimai⟧: just a tank top (nothing over it)
- タンクトップ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧: to wear a tank top
- ⟦{綿|めん}→綿：03807_men⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧タンクトップ: cotton tank top

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ノー→ノー：00324_noo⟧スリーブ: sleeveless top — broader; covers any sleeveless garment
- キャミソール: camisole — thinner straps, often worn as innerwear
